# Components

<!-- Generated by generate-indexes.mjs; edit contracts, then regenerate. -->

- **Button**
  - Description: Invoke one immediate action or navigate to one destination through a Hashti-styled native button, with pending and disabled states handled by ui-sdk.
  - Contract: [contract](components/button.md)

- **Checkbox**
  - Description: Check or uncheck one choice, or several through a group, with a native form participation and an indeterminate state for partly checked groups handled by ui-sdk.
  - Contract: [contract](components/checkbox.md)

- **Dialog**
  - Description: Opens a focused task over the page — editing a record, collecting a few details — with focus management, Escape and dismissal handled. The Hashti wrapper fixes the `hashti-dialog` classes on every part.
  - Contract: [contract](components/dialog.md)

- **Field**
  - Description: Connect a form control to its label, description and validation errors, wiring id, for and aria-describedby automatically, with field sets and groups for related fields.
  - Contract: [contract](components/field.md)

- **Input**
  - Description: Enter a short single-line text value — a name, email, search term — through a native input wired to its Field, with change reasons and clear-button support in ui-sdk.
  - Contract: [contract](components/input.md)

- **Menu**
  - Description: Chooses actions and settings from a button or a context menu, with arrow keys, typeahead and dismissal handled. The Hashti wrapper fixes the `hashti-menu` classes on every part.
  - Contract: [contract](components/menu.md)

- **Popover**
  - Description: Opens a small task — fields, buttons, other interactive content — beside its trigger, with placement, focus and dismissal handled. The Hashti wrapper fixes the `hashti-popover` classes on every part.
  - Contract: [contract](components/popover.md)

- **Select**
  - Description: Chooses one value or several from a popup list, with keyboard navigation and the value submitted with a form. The Hashti wrapper fixes the `hashti-select` classes on every part.
  - Contract: [contract](components/select.md)

- **Switch**
  - Description: Turn a setting on or off where the change takes effect immediately, with a sliding thumb and native form participation handled by ui-sdk.
  - Contract: [contract](components/switch.md)

- **Tabs**
  - Description: Switches between related panels with one tab selected at a time, through a tablist with arrow-key navigation. The Hashti wrapper fixes the `hashti-tabs` classes on every part.
  - Contract: [contract](components/tabs.md)

- **Textarea**
  - Description: Enter multiple lines of text — messages, notes, descriptions — through a native textarea wired to its Field, optionally growing with its text and submitting on a keyboard shortcut.
  - Contract: [contract](components/textarea.md)

- **Toast**
  - Description: Tell someone that something happened — a saved change, a sent message, a finished or failed promise — with actions, timed dismissal and screen-reader announcements, without taking focus.
  - Contract: [contract](components/toast.md)
